description: This file defines a serializer class for Spark's SparkPlanGraphWrapper objects, converting them to and from protobuf byte arrays. It includes methods for serializing/deserializing nodes, edges, and clusters within a Spark execution plan graph.

classes.description: Serializer class for SparkPlanGraphWrapper objects, handling protobuf serialization/deserialization.
